transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I guess I’ve just been feeling really worn down most of the time. Even when I sleep through the night, I don’t feel rested, and after work and dealing with things at home, I don’t have much left.
Do you find yourself enjoying things you used to like?

Yeah… not as much. I still do things, I mean, I go to the lab and I talk to people, but most days there’s just this kind of gray feeling in the background. Things like baking or checking the telescope don’t feel as… exciting, I guess, like they used to.
Do you still find pleasure in social interactions, like talking to people?

Some, I guess. I can still talk to people at the lab and get through it, but it doesn’t really feel… light. Most days there’s just this low gray mood in the background, so even things I used to enjoy don’t feel the same.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in?

A little, maybe. I still do things like baking sometimes, or checking on the telescope, but it’s not really the same. Most days there’s just this low, gray feeling kind of running in the background, so I don’t feel very excited about much.
Are there any things that you still look forward to?

Not really… I mean, I still go to the lab, and sometimes I think about baking or checking the telescope, but it’s more like I just do them. Most days that gray feeling is still there, so I don’t get that light or excited feeling much anymore.
Do you often feel guilty or blame yourself for things?
I don’t know… not especially. I mean, I can be hard on myself sometimes, but I wouldn’t say I’m sitting around feeling guilty all the time.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you used to enjoy?
I’m not sure I’d say I’ve lost interest completely. It’s more… muted, I guess. I still do some things, but they don’t pull me in the way they used to.
How long have you been feeling this way?
I guess… a little over two years now. It started not long after we moved into the older house, and it’s kind of just stayed as my baseline since then.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight since you started feeling this way?
Not really. I mean, my weight goes up and down a little like anyone’s, but I haven’t noticed anything significant.
Do you ever think about death or dying?
Not really… I mean, not in any serious way. Sometimes I think about the idea of it, I guess, but I don’t sit there planning or anything.
Do you feel like you're moving slower or faster than you used to?
I don’t think so. Maybe I feel kind of slow some days, but I haven’t really noticed that I’m actually moving slower or faster.
Do you feel like you have more or less energy than you used to?
Less, I guess. I feel worn down most of the time, even if I sleep enough. After work and dealing with stuff around the house, I don’t have much left.
Do you ever have thoughts that you would be better off dead?
No… not really. I don’t think of it like that.
Do you often feel anxious or worried about things?
I’m not sure. I mean, I worry about normal stuff, but I wouldn’t say it’s… a big thing.
Do you feel like you're resting or sitting still more often than you used to?

Yeah… probably more. I’m not sure I’d call it resting, exactly. I just feel worn down a lot, even after sleeping, and after work and dealing with the house I don’t have much left, so I end up sitting around more.
Have you had periods in the past where you felt significantly better than you do now?
Maybe before we moved into the old house, yeah. Since a little after that, a bit over two years ago, this has kind of been my normal.
Have you had any periods in the past two years where you felt completely back to normal for at least a couple of months?
No… I don’t think so. It’s been kind of the same low baseline since not long after we moved into that older house, a little over two years ago.
Do you have days where the gray feeling is completely gone?

Not really completely gone, no. Most days it’s just kind of there in the background… like a gray mood. I can still go to the lab and talk to people, but I don’t really feel light about things, even stuff I used to enjoy.
Are there any activities that you used to enjoy, but now you don't enjoy at all?
Yeah… baking, I guess. And checking the telescope. I still do some of it, but it doesn’t really feel like anything now. There’s just this gray mood in the background most days.
Have you had any period, even a short one, in the last two years where you felt your normal self again?
No… not that I can really point to. It’s felt like this same low baseline since shortly after we moved into that older house, a little over two years ago.
